SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Pronunciation and Interactive Listening, part of TECHNOLOGY: SCIENTIFIC INNOVATIONS Suggested Vocabulary engineer, computer scien in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: when seeking clarification, 1. How do you interrupt a speaker politely during a conversation?
